default_in_repayment.text: (a)The Company has not defaulted in repayment of loans or other borrowings or in the payment of interest thereon to any lender. (b)The Company has not been declared willful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or government or any government authority. (c) Term loan were applied for the purpose for which the loans were obtained. (d)On an overall examination of the financial statements of the Company, no funds raised on short-term basis have been used for long-term purposes by the Company. (e) On an overall examination of the standalone financial statements of the Company, the Company has not taken any funds from any entity or person on account of or to meet the obligations of its subsidiaries. (f) The Company has not raised loans during the year on the pledge of securities held in its subsidiaries. Hence, the requirement to report on clause 3 (ix)(f) of the Order is not applicable to the Company.

call_points.text: Crop Protection top line is guided to grow in double digits in FY27 with improved margins over Q4.
Crop Protection long-term EBITDA margin guidance reiterated at 15% to 17% for FY27.
Capex for FY27 will be limited to routine requirements of ₹35 crores to ₹40 crores.
Sulphuric acid price is above ₹30 per kg compared to below ₹5 per kg during normal periods.
Pigments segment revenue is expected in the range of ₹500 crores to ₹600 crores with higher margins than FY26.
Sanand plant capacity for Nano Urea is 5 crore bottles per year, accommodating new nano products without new capex.
Q4 export volumes and revenues were hit by soft macro demand, while rising input costs pressured margins.
Crop Protection Q4 production reached 10,294 MT at 74% capacity utilisation.
Pigments Q4 production dropped 35% YoY to 2,495 MT with capacity utilisation falling to 30%.
Sanand Nano Urea fertilizer plant has an installed capacity of 5 crore bottles (500 ml) per year.

operating_notes.text: Manufacture of Nano DAP, Nano NPK and Nano Zinc approved at Sanand facility with no additional capex.

FY26 standalone Crop Protection capacity utilisation stood at 72% on production of 40,371 MT; Pigments utilisation stood at 40% on production of 13,191 MT.
Consolidated debt-to-equity ratio stood at 0.47x as of March 31, 2026, with total debt of ₹722 Cr.

timeline.summary: CRISIL reaffirmed Meghmani Organics' long-term rating at A but revised the outlook to Negative for ₹1,094 Cr bank facilities.
On May 1, 2026, Meghmani Organics announced NCLT orders directing June 6, 2026 meetings for the amalgamation of Kilburn Chemicals and Meghmani Crop Nutrition.
Meghmani Organics corrected the schedule of creditor meetings for the scheme of amalgamation of Kilburn Chemicals and Meghmani Crop Nutrition.
Meghmani Organics' subsidiary received Ministry approval to manufacture nano fertilizers at its Sanand facility for the Kharif season.
Meghmani Organics Limited schedules Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 16, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST with Chairman & MD Ankit Patel, CFO G S Chahal, and Investor Relations Nishant Vyas.
Meghmani Organics issued its Q4FY26 investor presentation detailing segment operational headwinds and amalgamation voting timeline.
Meghmani Organics Limited shared Q4 FY2026 earnings call audio recording on May 16, 2026, via provided link.
Meghmani Organics held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for double-digit FY27 Crop Protection growth while keeping TiO2 operations suspended.
Meghmani Organics held its NCLT-convened shareholder meeting on June 6, 2026, to vote on the amalgamation of two wholly-owned subsidiaries.
India Ratings assigned IND A/Stable/IND A1 ratings to Meghmani Organics' bank loan facilities of ₹1,100 Cr.
